title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14280 South Military Trail in Delray Beach, Florida, as the "Benjamin Berell Ferencz Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 14280 South Military Trail in Delray Beach, Florida, as the Benjamin Berell Ferencz Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law names a Delray Beach, Florida, post office building after Benjamin Berell Ferencz.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility at 14280 South Military Trail in Delray Beach, Florida, as the Benjamin Berell Ferencz Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or any rules for the public.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025.
